findings.title: Hermes must use Kiro V3 ACP as primary (user decision); design pins V2
findings.fix: Vendor fork of hermes-kiro-provider@02c4dd06 at vendor/hermes-kiro-provider; launch `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine=v3` with no v2 flags; initialize capability negotiation; session/new with _meta.kiro modeId/modelId/effortLevel; model via session/set_config_option configId=model from models.yaml; shim deterministically rejects every session/request_permission; auth order KIRO_API_KEY -> --auth-method=client getAccessToken -> device flow; fake V3 ACP stdio contract tests + live doctor round-trip; real handshake probe recorded at build; V2 ACP becomes fallback 1.

findings.title: Commit author/committer/DCO identity must be 'Amsal Khan <md.amsalkhan@gmail.com>' (user decision); GitHub login stays Amsal1
findings.fix: Split identity.yaml into github_login / commit_name / commit_email; Signed-off-by: Amsal Khan <md.amsalkhan@gmail.com>; policy checks author==committer==sign-off==identity; setup-secrets pre-fills Amsal Khan; harness repo commits use repo-local config with no GIT_AUTHOR_*/GIT_COMMITTER_* overrides; drop A3.

findings.title: Coder container holds Kiro key alongside hostile code; 'Kiro hosts give no readable channel' unverified (server-side web tools, cloud sessions, kiro-cli in image)
findings.fix: Default to split coder: agent-llm container (key, kiro-cli, no shell tool, Kiro-only egress) + agent-exec container (no key, --network none) running deterministic ossbot-exec MCP tool; single-container mode only as logged downgrade after VERIFY 6/7 prove no attacker-directed egress via Kiro; add key-absence sandbox test.

findings.title: Approved diff is sandbox-produced, not gatekeeper-derived from pushed objects; base_sha not proven to be upstream history
findings.fix: Gatekeeper imports bundle into per-contribution bare repo, fetches upstream base_ref, requires base_sha ancestor of upstream and single squash commit with parent base_sha, generates numstat/patch/commit message itself for card/diff/.patch, binds patch_sha256 + commit_message_sha256, hardened git config; tests for patch mismatch and fabricated base.

findings.title: Control dir gatekeeper:osscontrol 2770 lets runner/sandboxd delete killed/paused flags (violates I9)
findings.fix: Dir 0750 / files 0640; only gatekeeper and root write; runner/sandboxd request stop via API; permission test as ossrunner/ossbox; watchdog kills on perm drift.

findings.title: Dry-run not bound: approval from a DRY RUN card can execute live after dry-run off
findings.fix: Binding field dry_run recomputed from current state; any dry-run toggle invalidates all pending/armed/confirmed approvals in the same transaction and re-issues cards; Confirm text states LIVE vs DRY RUN; unit + e2e test.

findings.title: False claims that Windows processes/IDE agents cannot approve or read secrets; any user-session process can `wsl.exe -u root`
findings.fix: Restate T7: Windows-user processes are root-equivalent and out of scope; ext4 secrets only defeat passive exposure; set WSL default user to unprivileged ossnobody (no ossapi); steering/AGENTS rules forbid dev agents touching secrets or wsl -u root; Telegram FYI on every operator go action.

findings.title: State transitions lack actor ownership; worker can drive approval-related states
findings.fix: ALLOWED maps edge -> actor {worker, gatekeeper_internal, human}; approval/submit edges forbidden to worker (403); parametrized test.

findings.title: /package allowed states, submit TOCTOU, and human title/body edits overwritten
findings.fix: /package only in PACKAGING (else 409); submit uses one immutable snapshot hashed and posted; store pr_title_override/pr_body_override that survive later revs.

findings.title: Watch fix/reply loops and claim gating missing from state machine; approval expiry vs 7-day EXPIRED undefined
findings.fix: Add WATCHING->IMPLEMENTING and WATCHING->WATCHING with watch_rounds max 3; VETTED->FETCHING requires issue_claim done when required; expired approval keeps AWAITING_APPROVAL with /approve re-issue, EXPIRED after 7 days.

findings.title: PR body/commit message review completeness on Telegram
findings.fix: Render body verbatim escaped in <pre>; show length/parts; send pr_body.md when long; Approve only after all parts delivered; show and scan gatekeeper-derived commit message.

findings.title: Security-relevant config read from Windows-writable drvfs with unspecified load semantics
findings.fix: policy/targets/egress/identity load only at start or human-confirmed /reload into gatekeeper ext4 snapshot served to other components; hard-coded floor for forbidden logins, denylist, workflow paths.

findings.title: Proxy topology unworkable (gateway IP, post-DNAT match, runner/hermes indistinguishable) and gatekeeper egress allows any 443/53 contrary to text
findings.fix: Set bip 10.211.0.1/24; ossbot-egress subnet 10.212.0.0/24, proxy --ip 10.212.0.2 no publish; per-uid ports 3140 runner, 3141 hermes, 3150 gatekeeper (telegram/github only) with owner-match iptables; keep proxy up during soft kill; per-uid probes.

findings.title: DNS exfiltration fallback for internal networks unspecified
findings.fix: Run sandboxes with --dns 127.0.0.1 --dns-search .; add dig probe against 127.0.0.11.

findings.title: Read-only task volume breaks kiro-cli HOME and outputs in research profiles
findings.fix: ro task volume + tmpfs /work/.home + per-run rw ossbot-out-<run_id> at /work/output; argv unit test.

findings.title: Summarizer profile conflict (agent vs research)
findings.fix: Summarizer in research profile with tools [read] only; update all sections.

findings.title: I2 contradicted: ossbox in docker group is root-equivalent and can read gatekeeper.env
findings.fix: Preferred: root-run ossbot-docker-filter UDS allowing only template-conformant API calls, ossbox not in docker group; minimum: amend I2 and list sandboxd as TCB.

findings.title: Gatekeeper cannot literal-scan the Kiro key; regex relies on unverified prefix
findings.fix: sandboxd scans artifacts/logs for literal key and encodings before publishing (fail + pause); gatekeeper gets KIRO_KEY_SHA256 and hash-checks token-like strings.

findings.title: Audit hash chain not tamper-evident against its owner
findings.fix: Root watchdog appends head anchors to chattr +a root-owned log; audit verify checks anchors; test.

findings.title: kill.ps1 on stopped distro boots services racing the flag; watchdog may restart Hermes while killed
findings.fix: Windows-writable .ossbot-local/KILL marker written first; root boot-gate unit converts it to killed before ossbot units; only resume removes both; watchdog never starts units while killed/paused.

findings.title: Test plan misses several safety properties
findings.fix: Add system kill test incl. reboot persistence, control-dir perms, dry-run toggle invalidation, gatekeeper-derived patch/fabricated base, worker-forbidden transitions, secret file EACCES per uid, live permission-deny probe, V3 ACP contract tests, per-uid egress probes, split-coder key absence, gatekeeper 3-host egress.

findings.title: No pipeline entry path for the first candidate contribution (V3 fork upstream to tobenwarrior/hermes-kiro-provider)
findings.fix: Add operator `ossctl contribution import` entering at VALIDATING through review/package/gatekeeper preview/two-tap approval; add repo to targets.yaml with human-tapped AI override; never pushed directly by the workflow.

findings.title: --security-opt seccomp=builtin unverified
findings.fix: Drop it (default profile applies) or tag [VERIFY].

findings.title: Missing [VERIFY] tags; model id regex may reject real ids
findings.fix: Tag Hermes approval keys and compose v5; accept exact catalog ids, regex only for --force.

findings.title: Package timestamp changes on retry, SHA unstable
findings.fix: Persist package_ts per rev and reuse.

findings.title: provision.sh runs from mount vs stream via stdin conflict
findings.fix: Stream via stdin in both.

findings.title: Undefined sandboxd socket group; prompt_file and subnet allocation unspecified
findings.fix: Define group osssbx; prompt_file regex ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,64}\.md$; persisted first-free /28 allocation.

findings.title: Inconsistent Telegram token patterns
Disclosure claims full diff review that is not enforced
findings.fix: Require View diff to last page before Approve, or reword.

findings.title: Discovery URL accepts /pull/ without defined semantics
findings.fix: Drop pull or define review-only behaviour.

findings.title: Hung gatekeeper leaves no Telegram kill
findings.fix: Watchdog writes paused after 4 failed health ticks.

findings.title: Hermes API on 127.0.0.1 forwarded to Windows
findings.fix: Bind 127.0.0.2 if supported [VERIFY]; keep bearer key.

findings.title: 'Run the project when cheap' not explicit in v1
findings.fix: Planner proposes T1s runtime smoke in validate profile for CLIs/binaries.

findings.title: Private harness-repo push readiness
findings.fix: Separate credential (never the gatekeeper PAT); add tools/bin/ and .ossbot-local/ to .gitignore now.
